citation: T.D. 95-77, Technical Corrections Regarding Customs Organization, 60 FR 50008 (Sept. 27, 1995)
note: Shows customs districts were eliminated only 'for the most part' and kept as geographical descriptions; the reason branch O3 (13 district orders) stays open.

Authority cited by every port and customs-district order after 1914; context for mechanisms M1-M3, and for checking later delegations (EO 10289 of 1951; transfer to the Secretary of Homeland Security).

citation: Act of May 24, 1924, ch. 182, 43 Stat. 140 (Rogers Act), sec. 18; Act of Feb. 23, 1931, ch. 276, 46 Stat. 1207, sec. 26
note: Retention, retirement and unhealthful-post authority quoted in the members (branches B09, B12-B17); context, and needed for branch O6 (EO 5644, 4696).

citation: Foreign Service Act of 1946, 60 Stat. 999; Foreign Service Act of 1980, Pub. L. 96-465, 94 Stat. 2071
note: Check for provisions expressly superseding or saving pre-1946 Foreign Service regulations and orders (branch O6, 11 members; and the parents of the B20 amendments). A repeal of authority alone would not end them.
